study: H6 Pauli-JW Hybrid PR versus RTE fairness extension

conditions.compiler: Qiskit1.3.0 rz/sx/x/cx opt1 seed17 no topology/layout override
conditions.state_reference: same saved raw ray and full-H reference; no regeneration

initial_precision: 128-bit Arb scalars / binary64 vector centers, existing tight L2 contraction engine
ambiguous_precision_policy: Do not silently increase allowance or change guards. Retain ambiguity, propose separately fixed necessary precision work within scope if justified.

confirmation.nominees: matched candidates if eligible plus union of per-epsilon expanded RTE exploration minima; preserve nomination view and post-confirmation family-min view
confirmation.extension_rule: On any of the five eps: G gap<=2 combined SE AND new nominal t95 halfwidth>1%G AND new SE>saved Hybrid comparator SE; stop unresolved at384

stage_policy: First run only the two matched candidates. Inspect results before registering additional exact configs and reasons. No automatic rerun of a completed batch or failed science call.
integer_extension: Same outward Fraction bounds/headroom/1%guard/confidence allocation; exact Python integer ceil and sufficient inequality verification only for former SAFE_INTEGER_LIMIT. Preserve old nulls.
resources: Workers chosen from observed available CPU; low priority own children; no arbitrary CPU/RAM cap, no shared changes
stop: Preserve failed calls without automatic retry; after scientific results, provenance, publication and local/remote SHA verification mandatory STOP
